sections.description: Connects Admetrics Data Studio with your WooCommerce installation.
sections.changelog:
0.5.1

  • Standardize installable plugin packages and release metadata.
  • Require WordPress 7.1.3 or later and PHP 8.2 or later; tested with WooCommerce 11.2.1.
  • Tracking behavior remains unchanged from 0.5.0.
